name: Golang for DevOps
headline: Golang for DevOps - Learn Automation Skills
short_description: Learn Golang for DevOps with hands-on tasks and real-world automation examples. Ideal for DevOps engineers looking to build practical tools and level up their skills. Connects to Kubernetes and other DevOps workflows.
author: techiescamp

sections.overview:
This skill provides a practical 8-week roadmap designed specifically for DevOps engineers learning Golang. It covers foundational Go syntax, file handling, networking, concurrency, and Kubernetes development using the client-go library. Through structured weekly modules and hands-on projects, you'll build CLI tools, REST APIs, Kubernetes operators, controllers, and system utilities. The roadmap addresses real DevOps workflows including YAML/JSON configuration parsing, RBAC management, security validation, and performance testing. By completing this roadmap, DevOps engineers gain the skills to create production-ready automation tools and extend Kubernetes functionality with custom operators.
Build Kubernetes operators and controllers for custom resource management
Create CLI tools for cloud operations and configuration validation
Develop job schedulers and concurrent task runners for infrastructure automation
Implement RBAC analysis tools and security validation utilities
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/techiescamp/golang-for-devops`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
